TEAM.name: MD Ibna Faysal
TEAM.bio: Leads EduRise in Bangladesh: student counselling, admissions and service standards. His own studies in Malaysia inspired him to start EduRise.
TEAM.story: MD Ibna Faysal leads the overall operations of EduRise Global in Bangladesh and is responsible for student counselling, admission management and the consultancy’s service standards. He studied in Malaysia, where his journey in international education began, and that experience inspired him to establish EduRise Global. Because he faced the same challenges himself, he focuses on honest, practical and student-focused guidance, so that every student gets accurate information and realistic expectations before a life-changing decision.

TEAM.name: Faysal Ahmed
TEAM.bio: Oversees European operations and supervises admissions for Malta, South Korea, Japan and other European destinations.
TEAM.story: Faysal Ahmed lives in Spain and oversees EduRise Global’s European operations and international coordination. He completed his studies in South Korea, moved to Austria for further study, and then settled in Spain. He supervises admission processes for Malta, South Korea, Japan and several European destinations, and strengthens EduRise Global’s academic network with first-hand knowledge of studying and living abroad.

TEAM.name: Raihan Gazi
TEAM.bio: Builds relationships with universities and explores new study destinations. ACCA qualified and runs his own business in the UK.
TEAM.story: Raihan Gazi is based in the United Kingdom and leads EduRise Global’s global partnerships and international collaborations. He has completed ACCA and runs his own professional business in the UK. His role is to build relationships with institutions, explore new study destinations and keep EduRise Global well connected across the global education industry.

TEAM.name: Md Shahriar Karim
TEAM.bio: Leads our bilateral operations from Sarawak, linking students from South Asia with universities in East Malaysia. Also General Manager of Sarawak Synergy Consultancy (SSC).
story: Md Shahriar Karim leads the bilateral operations of EduRise Global, serving as the strategic bridge between international student talent pools in South Asia and higher learning institutions in East Malaysia.

Operating permanently from Sarawak, Shahriar acts as the Regional Partner for EduRise Global while concurrently heading local ground operations as the General Manager for Sarawak Synergy Consultancy (SSC). Through this dual capacity, he ensures that the international recruitment and marketing strategies developed abroad are flawlessly executed and supported on the ground in Malaysia.

As an alumnus of the Malaysian higher education system with a background in software engineering, Shahriar possesses a firsthand understanding of the international student journey. He leverages this experience alongside his extensive background in Sarawak-based operations management to champion a high-touch stewardship model. His work focuses on establishing robust institutional partnerships, overseeing pre-arrival student screening protocols, and ensuring rigorous compliance with local immigration (JIMS) and educational standards.

Under his operational leadership, incoming international students receive structured orientation, seamless academic integration, and round-the-clock welfare advocacy throughout their tertiary education in Borneo.

TEAM.name: Sobzol Hosen Emon
TEAM.bio: Drives business development and strategic partnerships, helping EduRise Global grow in the international education sector.
story: At EduRise Global, Sobzol Hosen Emon is committed to driving business development, fostering strategic partnerships and contributing to the organisation’s long-term growth in the international education sector.
He believes that strong partnerships, strategic thinking and a student-centred approach are essential to creating meaningful global education opportunities.

Through collaborative leadership and a commitment to professional excellence, his goal is to help EduRise Global strengthen its position in the international education landscape while supporting students in pursuing their academic ambitions abroad.
TEAM.motto: Building Trust. Expanding Horizons. Empowering Futures.

NEWS.title: Gachon University MBA: March 2027 applications are open
NEWS.summary: Round 1 for the English-taught MBA at Gachon University near Seoul runs from 7 to 14 October 2026, with a 50% first-semester tuition waiver.
NEWS.body: Gachon University in Seongnam, 20 to 30 minutes from Seoul, is accepting applications for its March 2027 MBA intake. Round 1 runs from 7 to 14 October 2026 and Round 2 from 11 to 18 November 2026. Admitted students receive a 50% tuition waiver in the first semester. The minimum English requirement is IELTS 5.5. Talk to a counsellor to check your documents before the deadline.

NEWS.title: Kyungsung University opens Round 2 for Bachelor’s and transfer students
NEWS.summary: Busan-based Kyungsung University is taking first-year and transfer applications for March 2027 until 12 October 2026.
NEWS.body: Kyungsung University in Busan offers Bachelor’s programs in Global Business Administration, Global Hospitality Management, Global Korean Studies, International Studies, Global Mechanical Design Engineering and Global IT Engineering. Round 2 applications, including transfer applications, are open from 28 September to 12 October 2026. Scholarships of 30%, 40% or 50% for the first semester are linked to IELTS scores of 5.5, 7.0 and 7.5+.

NEWS.title: Fully funded Master’s places in Russia for 2027
NEWS.summary: Scholarship places cover tuition, a monthly stipend, dormitory accommodation and health insurance.
NEWS.body: Russian universities are offering fully funded Master’s places for the 2027 intake in engineering, computer science, business, economics, natural sciences, agriculture and the humanities. Applicants usually need a completed Bachelor’s degree with a CGPA of 2.70 or higher (some programs accept 2.50), and many programs do not require IELTS. A study gap of up to 10 years and an age limit of around 35 apply at most universities.

POLICIES.title: Privacy policy
paragraphs: We collect the details you send through our forms or WhatsApp, such as your name, phone number, email, qualification and preferred country, only to answer your enquiry and support your application.
We share your documents with universities, scholarship bodies or visa authorities only when you ask us to apply on your behalf. We do not sell your data.
You can ask us to correct or delete your details at any time by contacting us.

POLICIES.title: Terms of use
paragraphs: Content on this website is general guidance and does not create a service agreement. Services, fees and refund terms are confirmed in writing before any payment.
Program details, fees and dates may change. Always confirm the current details with a counsellor before you apply.

POLICIES.title: Disclaimer
paragraphs: Admission requirements, tuition, scholarships, work rights and family accompaniment rules are set by universities and governments, and they can change without notice.
EduRise Global cannot guarantee admission, a scholarship or a visa. Those decisions belong to the university, the scholarship body or the immigration authority.
University and scholarship names are used for information only and do not imply a partnership unless stated.
